declarations.header: def run {X A : Type*} (step : X → A → X) : X → List (ℝ × A) → ℝ → X | x, [], _ => x | x, event :: events, t => run step (if event.1 ≤ t then step x event.2 else x) events t /-- Original label: `defn:order-book-path-point-process`. Literal depth-restricted book recursion; source inputs have strictly increasing positive times, so reached events are exactly a prefix of the supplied list. -/ def bookPath (depth : ℕ) (initial : {m : Clearing.Market // Clearing.SortedMarket m}) (events : List (ℝ × Replay.Script)) (t : ℝ) : {m : Clearing.Market // Clearing.SortedMarket m} :=

declarations.header: theorem run_same_comparisons {X A : Type*} (step : X → A → X) (x : X) (events : List (ℝ × A)) (u v : ℝ) (h : ∀ event ∈ events, event.1 ≤ u ↔ event.1 ≤ v) : run step x events u = run step x events v :=

declarations.header: theorem run_all_future {X A : Type*} (step : X → A → X) (x : X) (events : List (ℝ × A)) (t : ℝ) (h : ∀ event ∈ events, t < event.1) : run step x events t = x :=

declarations.header: theorem run_eq_reached_prefix {X A : Type*} (step : X → A → X) (x : X) (events : List (ℝ × A)) (t : ℝ) (hsorted : events.Pairwise (fun e f => e.1 < f.1)) : run step x events t = (events.takeWhile (fun event => decide (event.1 ≤ t))).foldl (fun state event => step state event.2) x :=

declarations.docComment:
Independence of whole paths and of the restrictions within every path
implies independence of the full array of restrictions.
declarations.header: theorem restriction_array_independent (μ : Measure Ω) (paths : K → Ω → FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (hp : ∀ k, Measurable (paths k)) (hind : iIndepFun paths μ) (blocks : J → Set X) (hb : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (blocks j)) (hrow : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun j ω => restrict (paths k ω) (blocks j) (hb j)) μ) : iIndepFun (fun kj : K × J => fun ω => restrict (paths kj.1 ω) (blocks kj.2) (hb kj.2)) μ :=
declarations.name: restriction_array_independent

declarations.docComment:
Disjoint restrictions recover a finite counting measure whenever the
discarded complement has zero mass. This is equality of measures.
declarations.header: theorem sum_restrict_eq [Fintype J] (ν : FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (blocks : J → Set X) (hb : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (blocks j)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on blocks)) (hzero : (ν.1 : Measure X) (⋃ j, blocks j)ᶜ = 0) : PointProcessBootstrap.sum (fun j => restrict ν (blocks j) (hb j)) = ν :=
declarations.name: sum_restrict_eq

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:block-bootstrap-invariance`.
The deterministic selector theorem uses the source's whole-path independence,
equal path laws, within-path block independence, and zero discarded mass.
declarations.header: theorem deterministic_same_law [Fintype J] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (paths : K → Ω → FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (reference : K) (hp : ∀ k, Measurable (paths k)) (hind : iIndepFun paths μ) (hlaw : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (paths k) (paths reference) μ μ) (blocks : J → Set X) (hb : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (blocks j)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on blocks)) (hrow : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun j ω => restrict (paths k ω) (blocks j) (hb j)) μ) (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ((paths reference ω).1 : Measure X) (⋃ j, blocks j)ᶜ = 0) (choose : J → K) : IdentDistrib (fun ω => bootstrap (fun k => paths k ω) choose blocks hb) (paths reference) μ μ :=
declarations.name: deterministic_same_law

declarations.docComment:
A finite random mixture of equally distributed statistics has their
common law if the selector is independent of the underlying observations.
No independence among components of a vector-valued selector is required.
declarations.header: theorem independent_random_selection_same_law (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (selector : Ω → S) (observations : Ω → W) (reference : Ω → Y) (hs : Measurable selector) (ho : Measurable observations) (hr : Measurable reference) (hind : IndepFun selector observations μ) (statistic : S → W → Y) (hm : ∀ s, Measurable (statistic s)) (hlaw : ∀ s, IdentDistrib (fun ω => statistic s (observations ω)) reference μ μ) : IdentDistrib (fun ω => statistic (selector ω) (observations ω)) reference μ μ :=
declarations.name: independent_random_selection_same_law

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:block-bootstrap-invariance`.
An arbitrary random selector vector independent of the entire path vector
preserves the original point-process law.
declarations.header: theorem random_same_law [Fintype J] [Finite K] [MeasurableSpace K] [MeasurableSingletonClass K] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (paths : K → Ω → FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (reference : K) (hp : ∀ k, Measurable (paths k)) (hind : iIndepFun paths μ) (hlaw : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (paths k) (paths reference) μ μ) (blocks : J → Set X) (hb : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (blocks j)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on blocks)) (hrow : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun j ω => restrict (paths k ω) (blocks j) (hb j)) μ) (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ((paths reference ω).1 : Measure X) (⋃ j, blocks j)ᶜ = 0) (choose : Ω → J → K) (hc : Measurable choose) (hcind : IndepFun choose (fun ω k => paths k ω) μ) : IdentDistrib (fun ω => bootstrap (fun k => paths k ω) (choose ω) blocks hb) (paths reference) μ μ :=
declarations.name: random_same_law

declarations.docComment: The source's half-open time cells, indexed from zero in Lean.

declarations.name: timeBlocks

declarations.header: theorem measurable_timeBlocks {L : ℕ} (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (time : X → ℝ) (ht : Measurable time) (j : Fin L) : MeasurableSet (timeBlocks τ time j) :=
declarations.name: measurable_timeBlocks

declarations.docComment:
Ordered partition endpoints make the half-open cells disjoint, including

declarations.header: theorem timeBlocks_disjoint {L : ℕ} (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (time : X → ℝ) (hτ : MonotoneOn τ (Icc 0 L)) : Pairwise (Disjoint on (timeBlocks (L := L) τ time)) :=
declarations.name: timeBlocks_disjoint

declarations.docComment:
The only point of `[0,1]` omitted by the source's half-open time
partition is zero. No zero-mass condition is required at other endpoints.
declarations.header: theorem timeBlocks_compl {L : ℕ} (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (time : X → ℝ) (hτ : MonotoneOn τ (Icc 0 L)) (hfirst : τ 0 = 0) (hlast : τ L = 1) (htime : ∀ x, time x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : (⋃ j : Fin L, timeBlocks τ time j)ᶜ = time ⁻¹' {0} :=
declarations.name: timeBlocks_compl

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:block-bootstrap-invariance`.
The literal half-open time partition requires only the source's absence of
atoms at time zero; the discarded-mass condition is derived here.
declarations.header: theorem time_bootstrap_same_law {L : ℕ} (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (paths : K → Ω → FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (reference : K) (hp : ∀ k, Measurable (paths k)) (hind : iIndepFun paths μ) (hlaw : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (paths k) (paths reference) μ μ) (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (hτ : MonotoneOn τ (Icc 0 L)) (hfirst : τ 0 = 0) (hlast : τ L = 1) (time : X → ℝ) (ht : Measurable time) (htime : ∀ x, time x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hrow : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun j : Fin L => fun ω => restrict (paths k ω) (timeBlocks τ time j) (measurable_timeBlocks τ time ht j)) μ) (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ((paths reference ω).1 : Measure X) (time ⁻¹' {0}) = 0) (choose : Fin L → K) : IdentDistrib (fun ω => bootstrap (fun k => paths k ω) choose (timeBlocks τ time) (measurable_timeBlocks τ time ht)) (paths reference) μ μ :=
declarations.name: time_bootstrap_same_law

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:block-bootstrap-invariance`.
Full random-selector form for the literal time cells, with no requirement
that the selector coordinates be independent.
declarations.header: theorem time_random_bootstrap_same_law {L : ℕ} [Finite K] [MeasurableSpace K] [MeasurableSingletonClass K] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (paths : K → Ω → FiniteIntegerMeasures X) (reference : K) (hp : ∀ k, Measurable (paths k)) (hind : iIndepFun paths μ) (hlaw : ∀ k, IdentDistrib (paths k) (paths reference) μ μ) (τ : ℕ → ℝ) (hτ : MonotoneOn τ (Icc 0 L)) (hfirst : τ 0 = 0) (hlast : τ L = 1) (time : X → ℝ) (ht : Measurable time) (htime : ∀ x, time x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hrow : ∀ k, iIndepFun (fun j : Fin L => fun ω => restrict (paths k ω) (timeBlocks τ time j) (measurable_timeBlocks τ time ht j)) μ) (hzero : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ((paths reference ω).1 : Measure X) (time ⁻¹' {0}) = 0) (choose : Ω → Fin L → K) (hc : Measurable choose) (hcind : IndepFun choose (fun ω k => paths k ω) μ) : IdentDistrib (fun ω => bootstrap (fun k => paths k ω) (choose ω) (timeBlocks τ time) (measurable_timeBlocks τ time ht)) (paths reference) μ μ :=
declarations.name: time_random_bootstrap_same_law

declarations.name: central_reference_expectation

A full finite uniform-rank expectation theorem. The reference member can
be any index; only permutation invariance and absence of ties are required.

declarations.docComment:
The thesis's actual tie-adjusted statistic has precisely its displayed
central expectation under its exchangeability and no-ties hypotheses.
declarations.header: theorem expected_central_midrank {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B : ℕ} (values : Ω → Fin (B + 1) → ℝ) (hm : Measurable values) (hsymm : SymmetricLaw μ values) (hties : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Function.Injective (values ω)) (alpha : ℝ) : ∫ ω, (if EnsembleCalibration.central alpha (EnsembleRanks.midrank (values ω 0) (fun j : Fin B => values ω j.succ)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂μ = EnsembleCalibration.centralReference B alpha :=
declarations.name: expected_central_midrank

declarations.header: theorem upper_reference_count (B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1) : (∑ j : Fin (B + 1), if (j.val : ℝ) / B ≤ 1 - alpha then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = (Nat.floor ((B : ℝ) * (1 - alpha)) : ℝ) + 1 :=
declarations.name: upper_reference_count

declarations.header: theorem expected_upper_midrank {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (values : Ω → Fin (B + 1) → ℝ) (hm : Measurable values) (hsymm : SymmetricLaw μ values) (hties : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Function.Injective (values ω)) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1) : ∫ ω, (if EnsembleRanks.midrank (values ω 0) (fun j : Fin B => values ω j.succ) ≤ 1-alpha then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂μ = ((Nat.floor ((B : ℝ) * (1-alpha)) : ℝ) + 1) / (B + 1) :=
declarations.name: expected_upper_midrank

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:midrank-coverage-expectations`.
Averaging over days requires no independence between days.
declarations.header: theorem expected_central_fraction {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (values : Fin D → Ω → Fin (B + 1) → ℝ) (hm : ∀ d, Measurable (values d)) (hsymm : ∀ d, SymmetricLaw μ (values d)) (hties : ∀ d, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Function.Injective (values d ω)) (alpha : ℝ) : ∫ ω, EnsembleCalibration.centralFraction alpha (fun d => EnsembleRanks.midrank (values d ω 0) (fun j : Fin B => values d ω j.succ)) ∂μ = EnsembleCalibration.centralReference B alpha :=
declarations.name: expected_central_fraction

declarations.header: theorem expected_upper_fraction {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {B D : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hD : 0 < D) (values : Fin D → Ω → Fin (B + 1) → ℝ) (hm : ∀ d, Measurable (values d)) (hsymm : ∀ d, SymmetricLaw μ (values d)) (hties : ∀ d, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Function.Injective (values d ω)) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1) : ∫ ω, EnsembleCalibration.upperFraction alpha (fun d => EnsembleRanks.midrank (values d ω 0) (fun j : Fin B => values d ω j.succ)) ∂μ = ((Nat.floor ((B : ℝ) * (1-alpha)) : ℝ) + 1) / (B + 1) :=
declarations.name: expected_upper_fraction

declarations.header: theorem lower_reference_count (B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (a : ℝ) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) : (∑ j : Fin (B + 1), if (j.val : ℝ) / B < a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = (Nat.ceil ((B : ℝ) * a) : ℝ) :=
declarations.name: lower_reference_count

declarations.header: theorem central_reference_formula (B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (alpha : ℝ) (ha0 : 0 ≤ alpha) (ha1 : alpha ≤ 1) : EnsembleCalibration.centralReference B alpha = ((Nat.floor ((B : ℝ) * (1-alpha/2)) : ℝ) + 1 - (Nat.ceil ((B : ℝ) * (alpha/2)) : ℝ)) / (B + 1) :=
declarations.name: central_reference_formula

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `defn:parser-inner-outer-programs`.
Generic outer recursion, instantiated by the actual finite inner optimum in
`ParserPrograms.terminalValue`.
declarations.header: noncomputable def value (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ | 0, _ => 0 | _ + 1, 0 => 0 | n + 1, m + 1 => if allowed n m then max (max (value score allowed n (m + 1)) (value score allowed (n + 1) m)) (value score allowed n m + score n m) else max (value score allowed n (m + 1)) (value score allowed (n + 1) m) /-- A path through the Bellman lattice describes exactly a strictly increasing sequence of linked indices; skipped rows and columns carry no volume. -/ inductive Feasible (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → Prop | empty (n m : ℕ) : Feasible score allowed n m 0 | skipRow {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → Feasible score allowed (n + 1) m v | skipCol {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → Feasible score allowed n (m + 1) v | link {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → allowed n m → Feasible score allowed (n + 1) (m + 1) (v + score n m) theorem value_nonneg (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ value score allowed n m :=
declarations.name: value

declarations.docComment:
A path through the Bellman lattice describes exactly a strictly increasing
sequence of linked indices; skipped rows and columns carry no volume.
declarations.header: inductive Feasible (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → Prop | empty (n m : ℕ) : Feasible score allowed n m 0 | skipRow {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → Feasible score allowed (n + 1) m v | skipCol {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → Feasible score allowed n (m + 1) v | link {n m v} : Feasible score allowed n m v → allowed n m → Feasible score allowed (n + 1) (m + 1) (v + score n m) theorem value_nonneg (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ value score allowed n m :=
declarations.name: Feasible

declarations.header: theorem value_nonneg (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : 0 ≤ value score allowed n m :=
declarations.name: value_nonneg

declarations.header: theorem value_skipRow (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : value score allowed n m ≤ value score allowed (n + 1) m :=
declarations.name: value_skipRow

declarations.header: theorem value_skipCol (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : value score allowed n m ≤ value score allowed n (m + 1) :=
declarations.name: value_skipCol

declarations.header: theorem feasible_le_value (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] {n m : ℕ} {v : ℝ} (h : Feasible score allowed n m v) : v ≤ value score allowed n m :=
declarations.name: feasible_le_value

declarations.header: theorem value_attained (score : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (allowed : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) [DecidableRel allowed] (n m : ℕ) : Feasible score allowed n m (value score allowed n m) :=
declarations.name: value_attained

declarations.docComment:
Original label: `prop:parser-two-level-exactness`.
The generic outer optimum; the complete literal-MILP proposition is
`ParserAssembly.twoLevelBlockMatching_exactness`.

declarations.header: def allocations : List ReplayOrder → ℝ → List ℝ | [], _ => [] | o :: os, v => min (replayQuantity o) (max 0 v) :: allocations os (max 0 (v - replayQuantity o)) def notional : List ReplayOrder → ℝ → ℝ | [], _ => 0 | o :: os, v => replayPrice o * min (replayQuantity o) (max 0 v) + notional os (max 0 (v - replayQuantity o)) def bookOrders (b : Book) : List ReplayOrder := List.ofFn b.2
declarations.name: allocations

declarations.header: def notional : List ReplayOrder → ℝ → ℝ | [], _ => 0 | o :: os, v => replayPrice o * min (replayQuantity o) (max 0 v) + notional os (max 0 (v - replayQuantity o)) def bookOrders (b : Book) : List ReplayOrder := List.ofFn b.2

declarations.header: def raw (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (i : ι) : ℝ :=

declarations.name: weight

declarations.name: raw_nonneg

declarations.header: theorem mass_nonneg (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) : 0 ≤ mass distance gate offset :=
declarations.name: mass_nonneg

declarations.name: mass_pos_iff

declarations.header: theorem weight_nonneg (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (i : ι) : 0 ≤ weight distance gate offset i :=
declarations.name: weight_nonneg

declarations.header: theorem sum_weight (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) : ∑ i, weight distance gate offset i = 1 :=
declarations.name: sum_weight

declarations.header: theorem weight_le_one (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) (i : ι) : weight distance gate offset i ≤ 1 :=
declarations.name: weight_le_one

declarations.header: theorem raw_shift (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (i : ι) : raw distance gate offset i = Real.exp offset * raw distance gate 0 i :=
declarations.name: raw_shift

declarations.name: mass_shift

declarations.docComment:
Subtracting the minimum distance stabilizes exponents and leaves the exact
probabilities unchanged. The identity holds for every common offset.
declarations.header: theorem weight_shift (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (i : ι) : weight distance gate offset i = weight distance gate 0 i :=
declarations.name: weight_shift

declarations.header: theorem stable_exponential_bounds (distance : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hmin : ∀ i, offset ≤ distance i) (i : ι) : 0 < Real.exp (-(distance i - offset)) ∧ Real.exp (-(distance i - offset)) ≤ 1 :=
declarations.name: stable_exponential_bounds

declarations.header: def law (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) : PMF ι :=
declarations.name: law

declarations.header: theorem law_apply (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) (i : ι) : law distance gate offset hg hm i = ENNReal.ofReal (weight distance gate offset i) := rfl
declarations.name: law_apply

declarations.header: def checkedLaw (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) : Option (PMF ι) :=
declarations.name: checkedLaw

declarations.header: theorem checkedLaw_none_iff (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) : checkedLaw distance gate offset hg = none ↔ ∀ i, gate i = 0 :=

declarations.name: empty_library_fails

declarations.docComment:
The weighted expectation of any finite-library statistic; no moment
assumption is needed for finitely many finite-valued observations.
declarations.header: theorem expectation [MeasurableSpace ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) (f : ι → E) : ∫ i, f i ∂(law distance gate offset hg hm).toMeasure = ∑ i, weight distance gate offset i • f i :=
declarations.name: expectation

declarations.header: theorem empty_burst_allowed {Action : Type*} (distance gate : ι → ℝ) (offset : ℝ) (hg : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gate i) (hm : 0 < mass distance gate offset) (burst : ι → List Action) (i : ι) (hi : 0 < gate i) (hb : burst i = []) : [] ∈ ((law distance gate offset hg hm).map burst).support :=
declarations.name: empty_burst_allowed

declarations.docComment:
No substitute state update is assumed: this is the existing thesis
composite-action evaluator, applied to the compiled current-state indices.
declarations.header: theorem resolveRecords_composite {s : Ledger} (hs : Valid s) (records : List SourceRecord) : applyCompositeAction (market s) (compileScript s (resolveRecords s records).events) = market (resolveRecords s records).after :=
declarations.name: resolveRecords_composite

declarations.header: theorem resolveRecords_visible {s : Ledger} (hs : Valid s) (records : List SourceRecord) (depth : ℕ) : Visibility.visible depth (MarketSorting.sortMarket (applyCompositeAction (market s) (compileScript s (resolveRecords s records).events))) = visibleMarket depth (resolveRecords s records).after :=
declarations.name: resolveRecords_visible

declarations.header: theorem resolveRecords_empty (s : Ledger) : (resolveRecords s []).after = s ∧ (resolveRecords s []).events = [] ∧ (resolveRecords s []).statuses = [] ∧ (resolveRecords s []).tape = [] :=
declarations.name: resolveRecords_empty
